title: Contract revenue hides service burden

retrieve_on.symptom_narrative: We know revenue and payroll but not service cost by account. Short remote calls look like long on-site repairs when both count as one ticket. Driving, repeat visits and van parts are missing. Renewal prices follow intuition.

discriminating_questions.question: Are telephone and travel activities recorded?
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: High service cost may reflect an intentional strategic account or temporary project; profitability ranking alone does not dictate termination.

discriminating_questions.question: Can parts be assigned to an account?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Large items yes; van consumables often no.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Is technician time reliable?
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: What decision will the analysis support?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Scope and renewal discussions, not minute-by-minute employee monitoring.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

positive_mechanism: Inconsistent activity and cost attribution prevents meaningful contract-level economics.
counterexample: High service cost may reflect an intentional strategic account or temporary project; profitability ranking alone does not dictate termination.
minimum_evidence: A simulated activity sample contains calls missing from tickets.
A simulated stock review finds unassigned part usage.
A simulated contract comparison mixes remote and multi-person work.
process_intervention: Collect lightweight activity categories and parts attribution; disclose completeness; agree direct cost and overhead conventions separately.
automation_candidate: Aggregate attributable time and material cost; show ranges or unknowns for missing inputs and flag expensive repeat patterns.
unknowns: Loaded labor rates, overhead policy and actual usage must be measured locally.
stop_rule: If discriminating evidence is absent or conflicting, return an unresolved hypothesis plus a targeted question, not a confident solution.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Cost attribution and contract analytics are outside the existing six modules.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
